text: 8月7日，澳大利亚反倾销委员会发布第2026/101号公告称，延期发布对进口自中国的二氧化钛（Titanium Dioxide）反倾销调查基本事实报告和终裁。澳大利亚反倾销委员会预计将不晚于2027年4月6日完成本案调查的基本事实报告，不晚于2027年6月3日向澳大利亚工业、创新和科学部长提交终裁报告。2026年4月30日，澳大利亚反倾销委员会发布第2026/061号公告称，应澳大利亚国内企业Tronox Limited提交的申请，对进口自中国的二氧化钛启动反倾销调查。涉案产品的澳大利亚海关编码为3206.11.00.48。案件倾销调查期为2025年1月
text_en: On August 7, the Australian Anti-Dumping Commission issued Notice No. 2026/101, announcing a delay in releasing the essential facts report and final determination of its anti-dumping investigation into titanium dioxide imported from China. The Commission expects to complete the essential facts report for the case no later than April 6, 2027, and submit the final determination report to Australia's Minister for Industry, Innovation and Science no later than June 3, 2027. On April 30, 2026, the Commission issued Notice No. 2026/061, initiating the anti-dumping investigation into titanium dioxide from China following an application by Australian domestic company Tronox Limited. The Australian Customs tariff code for the subject goods is 3206.11.00.48. The investigation period for dumping is January 2025.
